_note: Aces AI control-card deck. The first BRAWLER card is a real transcribed card. The rest are TEMPLATES — replace every "TODO: ..." string with the real card text from your own copy. Add as many cards per role as you like; the Automate button draws a random one matching the unit's role. Roles are matched case-insensitively against the unit's Alpha Strike card role.

if_first.trigger: If this is the VERY FIRST AI unit to move this round because the AI team lost initiative.
if_first.action: RUSH TARGET. Ignore all cover and terrain filters. Move at maximum Ground Speed directly toward the closest enemy unit in your front arc. Gain +1 to your Target Movement Modifier (TMM) if you cross water or difficult terrain.

aggressive.condition: Enemy unit is within Short Range (0"-6") AND in line of sight.
filters: Move closer to the closest enemy, prioritizing their Rear Arc.
Avoid ending movement in a player's Firing Arc if possible.
Maximize physical attack opportunities (Charging/Death from Above).

balanced.condition: Enemy unit is within Medium Range (6"-24") OR AI armor is below 50%.
filters: Move toward the closest enemy, but maximize Heavy Cover / Woods.
Maintain Medium Range distance; do not close to Short Range.
Filter out positions that expose the AI's Rear Arc to any active enemy.

cautious.condition: AI unit is Shutdown, Immobilized, or out of ammo.
filters: If forced to move, choose the path that maximizes Defensive TMM.
Face the highest-threat enemy directly to utilize front armor.

target_selection: Target is in the AI's Front Firing Arc and has already completed its movement this turn.
Target is the Primary Target designated by the scenario's Commander Card.
Target requires the Lowest Target Number (TN) to hit.
Tie-Breaker: Target with the lowest remaining Armor/Structure.
combat.overheat: If this unit has the OV (Overheat) capability, it will Overheat OV+1 if the modified Target Number to hit its selected target is 8 or less.
special: Physical Attack Priority: If the AI ended its movement base-to-base with a player unit, it will automatically opt to Physical Attack (Kick/Punch) instead of firing short-range weapons if the physical attack damage is higher.
